meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude在规划功能或任务时,会先搜索阅读相关文档,弄清真实可用的API,再制定分阶段实现计划;每个阶段附文档依据、验证清单和禁止事项,最后统一验证。
howto.when: 当你要求规划新功能、任务或多步骤实现,尤其在动手执行代码之前会触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个用户登录功能,要分阶段计划。
实现前先按make-plan搜索文档,列出允许的API。
为这个修复写个实现计划,附验证步骤。
say.note: 会分阶段并给出验证清单

howto.what_en: Claude researches relevant docs first, then produces a phased implementation plan; each phase includes doc references, verification steps, and anti-pattern guards.
howto.when_en: When you ask to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do.

say_en.text: Plan a user login feature in phases for me.
Before coding, use make-plan to find docs and list allowed APIs.
Make a phased plan for this fix with verification steps.
say_en.note: It will give phases and a checklist.
